name: Jia Chen
psychographics: Optimizes for efficiency in every aspect of life; embraces automation and app-based services to maximize limited personal time.
current_solutions: Meituan Waimai for all meals; Didi Chuxing for all transport; smart home appliances controlled via Mi Home app.
frustration: The Meituan delivery app crashed precisely at 7 PM on a Friday, the peak dinner rush hour, leaving the family without food options for 45 minutes during the newborn’s feeding schedule.
decision_style: Rapid decision-making; switches between apps instantly based on real-time promotions and delivery ETA, loyal to none.
voice: Rambling and fast-paced; frequently mixes English phrases into Chinese sentences; uses filler words like "like" and "stuff" when explaining app workflows.
